_comment: Tier-2 for fenics hyperelasticity#3: ufl.variable(F) marks F as differentiation target; ufl.diff(W, F_var) returns a VariableDerivative usable in residual forms. _mutation.note: Antidote: skip the ufl.variable() wrapper — the exact step the pitfall says not to forget — and differentiate with respect to the bare F.
